label: Bible Study
prompt: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the _____.
verse: And Samuel grew, and the LORD was with him, and did let none of his words fall to the ground.
note: Young Samuel's track record — every word he spoke for God landed; none fell flat.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good _____ unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
verse: If ye then, being evil, know how to give good gifts unto your children, how much more shall your Father which is in heaven give good things to them that ask him?
note: If imperfect parents know how to give good gifts, Jesus says, imagine what the perfect Father has in mind.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like _____ made with honey.
verse: And the house of Israel called the name thereof Manna: and it was like coriander seed, white; and the taste of it was like wafers made with honey.
note: Manna's flavor review: white like coriander seed, tasting like wafers made with honey.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in _____ into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
verse: Neither by the blood of goats and calves, but by his own blood he entered in once into the holy place, having obtained eternal redemption for us.
note: Priests entered yearly with borrowed blood; Christ entered once with his own — and it never needs repeating.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little _____ in our bondage.
verse: And now for a little space grace hath been shewed from the LORD our God, to leave us a remnant to escape, and to give us a nail in his holy place, that our God may lighten our eyes, and give us a little reviving in our bondage.
note: Ezra's prayer counts small mercies: a remnant, a nail in the holy place, and 'a little reviving in our bondage.'
